observation: The film reads as a sequence of slides. The character stays in one idle pose and a small yaw does not make the narrated economic story unfold visually.
scope: User feedback on the delivered r03 final; prior technical QA and sampled visual checks remain evidence of those checks only.
requiredCorrection: Keep the exact existing narration, mix, real-photo receipts and bundled Vietnamese font.
Make the reusable renderer show content-specific action and state change inside beats.
Have the character interact with visible bread, receipts, flour, oven, basket or money props when the clause calls for it.
Each representative scene must develop from opening through an observable action to a changed state; crop, zoom, yaw, bob, blink, headline swap or static prop hold alone is insufficient.
Inspect complete moving proofs from the beginning, middle and end before any full-length rerender.
